pages.title: Design My Dream Graduation Cap
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Design My Dream Graduation Cap lets you create a graduation cap for a glamorous, doll-inspired character. This DIY dress-up game focuses on designing a look for the milestone celebration. Use the left mouse button or tap to make your selections.

pages.title: Wood Hexa Factory
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Run a sorting line in Wood Hexa Factory. Organize wooden hexagonal pieces and send them along conveyors to fill the matching trays and boxes. Plan the distribution so each production container receives the pieces it needs to complete its load.

pages.title: Dungeon Master – Cult & Craft
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Develop an underground following in Dungeon Master – Cult & Craft. Turn stick figures into devoted workers who mine ore and create resources for your domain. Manage their output and use the growing supply to expand the dungeon and strengthen the cult.

pages.title: Tripeaks Solitaire Escapes
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Clear summery card layouts in Tripeaks Solitaire Escapes. Select exposed cards one rank above or below the current discard, drawing from the stock when needed. Remove the complete tableau and use boosters when a difficult arrangement leaves few obvious moves.

pages.title: Fruit Goals Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Collect requested produce in Fruit Goals Match. Swap neighboring fruit into groups of at least three and meet the mission before using all the available moves. Plan which combinations advance the target rather than spending the allowance on unrelated matches.

pages.title: Xmas Hexa Sort
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Combine colored stacks in Xmas Hexa Sort. Drag hexagonal groups into open board positions and bring matching colors together until they clear. Keep enough room for later stacks, because a filled board without placement space ends the game.

pages.title: Butterfly Triple
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Release matching insects in Butterfly Triple. Place one of three offered shapes so at least three butterflies of a color touch and disappear. Earn points through those connections and plan consecutive combinations while preserving useful space on the board.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Witch Tower 2
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Restore magical rooms in Bubble Shooter Witch Tower 2. Aim colored shots into groups of at least three to clear levels and renovate new parts of the tower. Use boosters on difficult layouts and work toward earning three stars from each puzzle.

pages.title: Miracle Mahjong
pages.creator: Sanoma
pages.description: Clear connected pairs in Miracle Mahjong. Select identical tiles with free sides and a route that bends at most twice between them. Find pairs quickly to build a chain bonus, using a hint when necessary as you work through the panda's five tests.

pages.title: Driverz Ed
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Explore a large driving environment in Driverz Ed. Search for hidden puzzle pieces, unlock cars, and complete missions that mix racing with route planning. Fast travel and mission tracking help you navigate between activities while investigating more of the open world.

pages.title: Ultrahero Vs Monsters Royale Battle
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Protect a base while fighting enemy waves in Ultrahero Vs Monsters Royale Battle. Control the hero in three-dimensional encounters and use defensive tactics alongside direct combat. Keep the monsters away from the base as the battles become more demanding.

pages.title: Looper
pages.creator: Kwalee
pages.description: Send musical beats around looping paths in Looper. Time each tap so the moving pieces can share the constellation without crashing into one another. More complex arrangements create additional intersections, requiring you to stagger their movement carefully to keep the pattern running.

pages.title: Brick Match
pages.creator: uk4dee games ltd
pages.description: Clear colored groups in Brick Match. Tap matching bricks to trigger combinations and complete the level's puzzle. Use tools such as a color bomb, row blaster, shuffle, or extra moves when the remaining arrangement makes the next clear difficult.

pages.title: Bolts
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Release fasteners in the right sequence in Bolts. Inspect the puzzle and choose which bolt to unscrew so the remaining pieces can still be removed. Each level changes the arrangement, making the order of your actions central to completing the challenge.

pages.title: Swordsman Adventure
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Fight mission-based encounters in Swordsman Adventure. Use a sword against enemies with different amounts of health, then collect rewards when the assignment is complete. Spend the earnings on stronger attacks or a new weapon before continuing the soldier's adventure.

pages.title: Rollance Going Balls
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Guide a colorful ball along raised routes in Rollance Going Balls. Roll and jump across the platforms while watching for moving hammers. Keep the ball on safe ground as you work through courses that mix careful handling with avoiding sudden impacts.

pages.title: Bbq Stack Run
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Collect ingredients during a food-themed race in Bbq Stack Run. Guide the runner toward meat such as chicken, sausage, and beef, then add seasoning and cook the gathered items. Complete the route while assembling the growing barbecue selection.

pages.title: Cross Connect Word
pages.creator: Viroh Games
pages.description: Build crossword answers in Cross Connect Word. Drag through alphabet letters to form words and fill the puzzle's missing entries. Keep testing useful letter combinations as you uncover the answers needed to complete the current word grid.

pages.title: Count Master Match Color Run
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Grow a color-coordinated crowd in Count Master Match Color Run. Collect characters matching the group and merge them into a larger team. Keep the runners clear of spikes and hammers while trying to finish with enough members for a stronger score.

pages.title: Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Race motorcycles through city streets and highways in Motorcycle Racer: Road Mayhem. Avoid collisions with traffic and unlock machines with different handling as you progress. Upgrade the selected bike's performance to support further runs through the busy roads.

pages.title: TapTapBOOM
pages.creator: MadeByChaz
pages.description: Solve explosive physics puzzles in TapTapBOOM. Tap twice to place bombs, then tap again to detonate them and change the level's arrangement. Trigger TNT or switches when useful and work out how the resulting movement completes each of thirty challenges.

pages.title: Zombie Defense: War
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Hold back enemy crowds in Zombie Defense: War. Buy spaces for towers, place the defenses, and merge or boost them to improve their strength. Move through different environments while keeping the remaining human sanctuaries protected against progressively harder levels.

pages.title: Zombie Mission Survivor
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Defend against waves of mutated enemies in Zombie Mission Survivor. Earn gold from defeated zombies and upgrade weapons, armories, and income during the action. Play alone or cooperate with a second hero, improving both characters as the attacks continue.

pages.title: Cake DIY 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Decorate a dessert in Cake DIY 3D. Apply different colors of cream and add fruit, seeds, or other finishing choices to complete the icing. Experiment with the available combinations to create a finished cake design of your own.

pages.title: Doll Cake Maker
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Create an elaborate doll design in Doll Cake Maker. Choose a skirt style, add patterns and decorative details, and refine its outline for a finished look. The styling activity focuses on coordinating the shape and embellishments of the doll's dress-like design.

pages.title: Block Puzzle Sudoku
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Fit geometric blocks onto the board in Block Puzzle Sudoku. Fill horizontal or vertical lines to clear them and make room for further pieces. Consider the next shapes before placing one, because the game ends when none of the offered blocks will fit.

pages.title: Drag Racing City
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Compete in tuned-car events in Drag Racing City. Choose among four locations and several race types, from story progress to leaderboard contests or adjustable custom races. Modify the vehicles and difficulty while working toward defeating rivals and improving your racing rank.

pages.title: Jungle Jewels Connect
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Connect identical produce tiles in Jungle Jewels Connect. Each pair needs a clear route made from no more than three straight segments. Watch the timer, spend hints carefully, and clear boards to build a higher score for the global leaderboard.

pages.title: Quiz - Guess the flag
pages.creator: Doto Play
pages.description: Identify national symbols in Quiz - Guess the flag. Look at the displayed flag and choose its country from four answer buttons. Continue through the collection of more than two hundred flags, using each question to practice recognition.

pages.title: Yatzy Multi player
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Share a dice contest with friends in Yatzy Multi player. Create a lobby game or use quick play to join an available match. Roll during your turn and choose results for scoring combinations as you compete to finish with the better total.

pages.title: Word Search
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Find the listed answers in Word Search. Drag through letters arranged horizontally, vertically, diagonally, or backward to highlight a complete word. Use a hint when stuck and check the calendar for further puzzles beyond the current grid.

pages.title: Memory Emoji
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Reveal matching faces in Memory Emoji. Turn tiles over, remember which symbols they hide, and locate identical partners to clear the board. Eight levels increase the complexity of the arrangements, giving you larger memory challenges as you progress.

pages.title: Steve Go Kart Portal
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Repair gateways while driving in Steve Go Kart Portal. Guide the kart toward each level's portal and avoid archers' arrows, webs, lava, and water along the way. Use the stopping control and double jumps to handle difficult crossings safely.

pages.title: Pirate Jack
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Cross an occupied ship in Pirate Jack. Move and double-jump past hostile pirates and deadly guns while trying to reach the character's treasured chest. Survival through the vessel's obstacles is part of completing the route to the cargo he wants to recover.

pages.title: Food Junction
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Move food pieces into matching lines in Food Junction. Select an item and then an empty cell to relocate it, forming rows or columns of at least three identical pieces. Remove groups for points while keeping useful movement space available.

pages.title: Spidey Man Rescue Online
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description: Free captives with web attacks in Spidey Man Rescue Online. Shoot enemies to immobilize them and work through the levels protecting the citizens held by a criminal group. Successful rescues and defeated opponents earn coins as the hero continues the mission.

pages.title: Kitty Cats
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description: Care for a chosen pet in Kitty Cats. Feed it, dress it up, and play with toys such as yarn, a toy mouse, or a cardboard box. Hold the mouse button or touch input to pet the cat during its daily activities.

pages.title: Secret of Amun
pages.creator: WHOW Games GmbH
pages.description: Play an Egyptian-themed virtual slot machine in Secret of Amun. Set the coin stake and spin the reels to look for winning combinations. The presentation uses pyramids and ancient treasure as the setting for its reel-based casino game.

pages.title: Onet Winter Christmas Mahjong
pages.creator: UCoolGames.com
pages.description: Pair matching holiday tiles in Onet Winter Christmas Mahjong. Connect them with a path using at most three straight segments and clear the board. Some layouts move after a match, while limited hints and shuffles require you to plan their use carefully.

pages.title: Slings to the Basket
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Launch a character between anchor points in Slings to the Basket. Collect fruit, bounce from the sides, and avoid obstacles while finding a route into the basket. Move quickly away from red points because they disappear after a brief pause.

pages.title: Who was who
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Match childhood and adult celebrity pictures in Who was who. Study the available faces and draw a line between photographs showing the same person at different ages. The puzzle centers on recognizing lasting features across the paired images.

pages.title: Ultra Pixel Survive
pages.creator: Gold Skull Studios
pages.description: Build shelter and survive hostile lands in Ultra Pixel Survive. Gather resources, craft useful equipment, and fight enemies while developing a home for the character. Switch tools, jump, and dodge as you balance construction work with the surrounding threats.

pages.title: Ball Hit
pages.creator: DRA
pages.description: Rearrange obstacles to score a basket in Ball Hit. Move or rotate the objects that interfere with the basketball's route, then create a trajectory leading through the hoop. Each level changes what must be adjusted to make the shot work.

pages.title: Happy Milk Glass
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Dig a channel for a dairy stream in Happy Milk Glass. Use the shovel-drawing control to open a route that carries milk into the bucket. Thirty physics puzzles test how your excavation changes the flow through the level.

pages.title: Black Hole Billiard
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pocket every red ball in Black Hole Billiard. Drag to set a shot's angle and power, then strike toward the black hole. Clear all the targets to finish the level and continue through eleven solo billiards challenges.

pages.title: Christmas Ski
pages.creator: Sakura Games
pages.description: Collect presents while skiing in Christmas Ski. Jump over logs, use a second jump in the air, and hold the control to perform backflips. Gifts help Thomas buy new clothing and skis as he gathers supplies for Santa.

pages.title: Critical Strike Zero
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Compete against other shooters in Critical Strike Zero. Explore detailed maps and use a selection of modern firearms to eliminate rival players in deathmatch. Buy weapons, reload, and keep moving as you try to survive the armed encounters.

pages.title: Best Link
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Clear paired picture cards in Best Link. Select two matching images that can be joined with no more than three straight lines. Remove all available pairs to finish the stage, using the open spaces to reach cards that were previously blocked.

pages.title: 365 Solitaire Gold 12 in 1
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Choose among twelve card variants in 365 Solitaire Gold 12 in 1. Play familiar formats such as Klondike, FreeCell, Golf, Pyramid, and Spider, each with its own rules. Daily deals and seasonal presentation changes offer further reasons to return to the collection.

pages.title: Knight War Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Color illustrated fantasy fighters in Knight War Coloring. Choose one of eight pictures and apply shades from a twenty-three-color palette. Complete the design with your preferred combination of colors and save the finished image when you are satisfied with it.

pages.title: Opel GT Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Restore photographs of a sports car in Opel GT Slide. Select one of three images and choose a puzzle mode before rearranging the sections. Compare bodywork and background details to bring the scrambled picture back into its complete layout.

pages.title: Join & Clash
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Fight through encounters between opposing crowds in Join & Clash. Slide to direct the character and confront the red and blue fighters positioned around the battlefield. Work through the hand-to-hand conflicts as the adventure leads toward rescuing the princess.

pages.title: My Ice Cream Truck
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Serve frozen desserts from a mobile counter in My Ice Cream Truck. Prepare treats such as shortcake ice cream or milkshakes and explore the available dessert-making choices. The game centers on creating the sweets you offer from your own ice-cream service.

pages.title: Dream Book Jigsaw
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Reassemble storybook artwork in Dream Book Jigsaw. Choose a difficulty and fit the scattered sections together to reveal an illustration from the book. Continue through the collection's bedtime-story scenes, comparing shapes and picture details to complete each puzzle.

pages.title: Soccer Farm
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Help an unlikely footballer score in Soccer Farm. Aim to put as many balls into the goal as the level requires while guiding the farmer through the challenge. Keep working on successful shots as you progress through the rural football setting.

pages.title: Tank Battle
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Drive an armored vehicle into combat in Tank Battle. Control the tank's movement, rotate the gun, and switch between two weapons as you attack opposing tanks. Keep the vehicle alive while lining up useful shots during the battlefield encounters.

pages.title: Extreme Water Surfer Bus Simulator
pages.creator: RealGame Studio
pages.description: Take a large passenger vehicle onto water in Extreme Water Surfer Bus Simulator. Drive through the aquatic environment and work through challenges using different buses. The simulation combines coach handling with routes set across a sea-themed driving area.

pages.title: War Plane
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Fight airborne enemies in War Plane. Fire at opposing aircraft while keeping your own plane away from their bullets. Continue destroying targets and avoiding incoming attacks as you work on surviving longer through the aerial battle.

pages.title: Angry Infected 2D
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Use aimed shots to attack sheltered undead in Angry Infected 2D. Fire into the level's blocks and try to reach the infected targets behind them. Work through successive arrangements as you test which shots can eliminate the zombies.

pages.title: Red Monster
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Defend a threatened city in Red Monster. Move a superhero through enemies, throw vehicles, and use direct or special attacks to protect civilians. Complete levels and choose among three character appearances while confronting the monsters invading the streets.

pages.title: Crush The Candy
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Clear the sweets appearing on-screen in Crush The Candy. React to the newly spawned targets and crush each one as the activity continues. The challenge focuses on dealing with the incoming candies rather than leaving pieces untouched in the play area.

pages.title: Stay On The Road
pages.creator: TD2TL
pages.description: Drift around a circuit in Stay On The Road. Hold the mouse button or touch control to turn, then judge when to straighten for the next section. Complete more laps and gather coins to purchase additional cars.

pages.title: Hill Climbing
pages.creator: GameOnHai
pages.description: Drive over uneven terrain in Hill Climbing. Control acceleration and reverse movement to prevent the car from crashing on the bumpy road. Travel as far as possible and use each attempt to work toward a stronger distance record.

pages.title: Color Hockey
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Push the puck toward the opposing goal in Color Hockey. Control your hockey piece with the mouse and work around the obstacles separating it from the target. Compete against the computer and try to finish with the greater number of goals.

pages.title: TrollFace Quest: USA 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Solve comic prank scenes in TrollFace Quest: USA 2. Click objects and characters to discover the unexpected action that advances each level. The journey targets fictionalized celebrities, television figures, and politicians with puzzles built around absurd outcomes.

pages.title: Happy Color
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Add your own palette to illustrated scenes in Happy Color. Choose a picture and fill its areas using the available coloring choices. Work through the details until the drawing becomes a finished image in the combination of shades you prefer.

pages.title: Old Road Jeep Jigsaw
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Rebuild off-road vehicle scenes in Old Road Jeep Jigsaw. Choose among twelve pictures and select a puzzle with 25, 49, or 100 pieces. Arrange every section to complete the selected jeep image before trying another difficulty.

pages.title: Math Fever
pages.creator: Puzzle Games
pages.description: Judge arithmetic statements quickly in Math Fever. Choose the right or wrong button according to whether the displayed calculation is valid. Correct responses raise the score and reset the time bar, while the countdown accelerates as the sequence continues.

pages.title: Crazy Cowboy Match 3
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Match illustrated pieces in Crazy Cowboy Match 3. Form rows of at least three identical images to score while keeping the side meter from dropping too far. Keep finding productive combinations to maintain the game and improve your total.

pages.title: Archery Training
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Compensate for shifting conditions in Archery Training. Aim arrows at the center of the target and adjust as increasing wind makes accurate shots harder. Use the mouse or touch controls to practice placing each arrow despite the changing force.

pages.title: Real Indian Truck Cargo Truck Transport
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Deliver a load without losing it in Real Indian Truck Cargo Truck Transport. Handle the truck along the transport route and keep the cargo aboard until the endpoint. The driving task depends on reaching the destination with the goods intact.

pages.title: Commando Sniper: CS War
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Complete armed assignments in Commando Sniper: CS War. Move through enemy territory, change weapons, and fire at hostile forces during the missions. A slow-time control and map offer additional tools as you work through the combat scenarios.

pages.title: The Lost Chicken
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Guide a descending bird through obstacles in The Lost Chicken. Work down the revolving course and keep clear of trees that can end the attempt. The challenge is to manage the fall and reach the bottom without destroying the chicken.

pages.title: Fun Truck Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Assemble commercial-vehicle pictures in Fun Truck Jigsaw. Choose one of twelve images and an easy, medium, or hard arrangement. Fit 25, 49, or 100 pieces together to complete the selected truck illustration at your chosen level of detail.

pages.title: Piano Online
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Perform songs by following scrolling keys in Piano Online. Select a tune from the available list, then tap its tiles in the required order. Keep responding accurately as you work through the musical sequence of the chosen song.

pages.title: Army Attack
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Complete military shooting assignments in Army Attack. Choose among the available weapons and fight armed enemies while working toward each mission's objectives. Keep your soldier alive through the encounters and adapt the equipment to the threats ahead.

pages.title: Baby Cow Launcher
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Launch unusual animal projectiles in Baby Cow Launcher. Aim young cows at the greedy farmers and use their different abilities to win each encounter. Power-ups and obstacles such as crates, glass, and windmills create different ways to solve the physics-based stages.

pages.title: Ludo
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Race four tokens home in Ludo. Roll a six to bring a piece into play, then use later dice results to move it toward your colored central area. Up to four people can compete, choosing which token to advance on each turn.

pages.title: Rugby Kicks
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Kick for points in Rugby Kicks. Tap at the appropriate moment to set the direction of the ball, then try to send it through the scoring area. Keep judging the timing as the crowd watches your sequence of attempts.

pages.title: Colors Swap
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Guide a ball upward through matching sections in Colors Swap. Time jumps so the character passes only through its current color. Contact with the wrong color destroys the ball, making each change part of planning the next safe crossing.

pages.title: Sweet Cats Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Paint feline illustrations in Sweet Cats Coloring. Choose a picture and use the brush with your preferred colors to fill its outlined parts. Build a distinct palette for the cat and complete the image at your own pace.

pages.title: Blackjack Tournament
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Play a casino-style card contest in Blackjack Tournament. Take cards to approach twenty-one without exceeding it, then decide when to stand against the bank. Manage the hand choices through the tournament while trying to finish with a stronger valid total than the dealer.

pages.title: Knife Up
pages.creator: Hack TheREALITY
pages.description: Send a blade higher in Knife Up. Collect coins, improve the knife's power, or purchase another design as you work toward greater height. A multiplayer option lets friends on the same Wi-Fi connection compare their knives in the climbing contest.

pages.title: Cyber City
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Fight rooftop rivals in Cyber City. Move through the elevated urban setting and beat other stick figures while trying to build wealth. The game connects its street-fighting encounters with the character's effort to become richer.

pages.title: Keep It Alive
pages.creator: F2K2.com
pages.description: Shield a young creature in Keep It Alive. Protect the baby monster from falling obstacles while collecting stars during the physics challenge. Spend those stars to obtain additional monsters, then work on preserving the next character through the incoming hazards.

pages.title: Shiba Rescue Dogs and Puppies
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guide tired puppies toward their beds in Shiba Rescue Dogs and Puppies. Draw paths across the floor and keep the routes away from larger dogs. Each level changes the arrangement, requiring another safe plan for bringing the puppies home to sleep.

pages.title: Astronaut Warrior
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Explore space and fight hostile creatures in Astronaut Warrior. Use your ship and spacesuit to survive the monsters encountered along the journey. Improve both pieces of equipment as you work toward handling the threats farther into the universe.

pages.title: Circle Jump
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Keep a character moving inside a circular course in Circle Jump. Jump to avoid the wall and collect money during the attempt. Use the proceeds to buy additional characters while working toward a longer run through the obstacle challenge.

pages.title: Princess All White Night Party
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Coordinate pale outfits in Princess All White Night Party. Help Jasmine, Moana, and Mulan dress for a VIP event whose theme requires everyone to wear white. Compare clothing and accessories to give each princess a distinct look within the shared color scheme.

pages.title: Epic Robot Tournament
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Build a combat machine in Epic Robot Tournament. Assemble the robot, then use it to fight rival machines in a series of encounters. Defeat the opposing robots as you work toward becoming the sole winner of the tournament.

pages.title: Christmas Santa Claus Game
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Give a holiday icon a new wardrobe in Christmas Santa Claus Game. Explore the dress-up choices and create a different seasonal look for Santa. Combine the available clothing and accessories into a finished outfit for the Christmas celebration.

pages.title: Forest Village Getaway Episode 2
pages.creator: Snapbreak Games AB
pages.description: Search a deserted settlement in Forest Village Getaway Episode 2. Explore the scenes, inspect objects, and work through the puzzles blocking a route out. The second episode offers another escape from the forest village, asking you to discover a different solution to leaving it.

pages.title: Ice Queen Acne Treatment
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Complete a character makeover in Ice Queen Acne Treatment. Work through the illustrated facial-care and spa activities before adding makeup for her event. The game combines attending to the princess's skin with choosing cosmetics for the finished party look.

pages.title: Annie Tailor Shop
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Design a custom garment in Annie Tailor Shop. Choose materials, patterns, colors, and a dress style for the outfit Annie will make. Compare combinations and put together a personalized design as the shop prepares clothing for its clients.
